description: Two four-input polyphonic AND gates, working bit by bit across up to 16 channels.

inputs.text: One of the four inputs into that gate; an input with nothing patched into it is ignored.

outputs.text: Carries a high on each channel where all four inputs into that gate are high on that channel, and a low elsewhere; it has as many channels as the first of that gate's four inputs.

menu: Digital Voltage Range — a submenu of 0-1V, 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V and -10V to 10V, setting the pair of voltages used for low and high; an input reads high above the midpoint of the pair.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
